key_idea: Use discharging rules to prove that every internally 6-connected triangulation must contain at least one of 633 reducible configurations.
reason: Although the high-level framework of discharging and reducible configurations is logical, the proof is the epitome of brute-force computer verification. It provides no human-surveyable explanation for why the theorem holds, burying the result under massive, mechanical case analysis.
recognized: Four Colour Theorem (Robertson, Sanders, Seymour, and Thomas, 1997)
